summary: Phase 0-3 admission passes and all 31 synthetic validator counterexamples pass, but live Phase-4 acceptance is blocked: 10 live tests fail for the absent independent review, committed predecessor receipts are incompatible with the validator adapter, no live artifact bundle invokes the validator, and plan evidence is stale.

blocking_findings.title: Committed predecessor receipts cannot enter the Phase-4 validator
blocking_findings.detail: The frozen authority requires five distinct roles and ten provenance fields. Only three predecessor receipt files exist. discovery-auditor has null ancestry/context/event fields, no actual_usage, no stop_loss_observations, no output_hashes, and a mapping-valued output_sha256. evidence-collector lacks stop_loss_observations. requirements-mapper declares role reconciliation-integrator, has seven null required provenance fields, and lacks actual_usage and stop_loss_observations. The 43-test admission suite does not pass these committed receipts through the production validator.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Produce truthful provider-attested predecessor receipts with exact role/provenance fields, canonical output hashes, measured usage, and zero numeric stop-loss observations, then admit those exact committed receipts through the production adapter before reviewer launch.

blocking_findings.title: No committed adapter validates the live Phase-4 schemas as one transition
blocking_findings.detail: validate_phase4_inventory_acceptance has no caller outside its test module. The passing Green control uses temporary synthetic record_sets/rerun_record_sets artifacts and synthetic events. The live acceptance class separately asserts independent-review/candidate/owner/accepted fields but never builds a production bundle or invokes the validator on the live bytes. Exact candidate-to-review-to-owner-to-accepted compatibility is therefore indirect and synthetic, not reproduced on live artifacts.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Add a committed live-schema bundle builder and a fail-closed test that feeds exact committed Phase 0-4 artifacts and provider events through validate_phase4_inventory_acceptance.

blocking_findings.title: The live Phase-4 lifecycle has not executed
blocking_findings.detail: independent-review.json, adversarial-reviewer receipt, both candidate manifests, product-owner acceptance, and both accepted manifests are absent. The focused suite ran 41 tests: 31 synthetic validator tests passed and all 10 live acceptance tests failed at setUp for the missing independent review. No live owner-bound four-hash transition exists to accept.
evidence: All failures: Missing Phase-4 independent-acceptance artifact independent-review.json
Committed track tree: seven required Phase-4 lifecycle artifacts absent
blocking_findings.required_remediation: After predecessor admission is genuinely Green, run the fresh fork_turns=none reviewer, remediate all CHM findings, publish non-consumable candidates, obtain exact four-hash owner authorization, then publish accepted manifests and rerun acceptance.

blocking_findings.title: Plan and test-strategy evidence is stale
blocking_findings.detail: The docs still claim 32/32 admission, absent validator, 35 focused failures with LEGACY_PHASE4_FAIL_OPEN, 118 surfaces, and Phase-3 SHA-256 cd72b34a.... Current reproduction is 43/43 admission, a present validator, 31 passing counterexamples plus 10 missing-review failures, 102 surfaces, and SHA-256 8838480634acce470430098b002b9c9468a7c53022a413ee24002c4e0c3e6c2c. metadata in_progress, the active registry row, and blocked Phase-4 markers remain truthful.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Refresh evidence-only plan/strategy text without advancing Phase-4 markers or the truthful in-progress lifecycle state.

nonblocking_findings.title: Frozen authority and locator-shape remediation works in isolation
nonblocking_findings.detail: The Phase-0 freeze SHA-256 equals its ownership binding; baseline 23bb5ad578c01fb29f9e8bb76a7d934d24a4b286 and predecessor hash d9f5c4771a755bae72c037fdbed6e330e523e9f2fabf60010154b981bfb283a3 are enforced by passing counterexamples. All 9,388 locator-shaped mappings in committed Phase 3 are recognized by the current flat/nested locator adapter.
